condition: An arithmetic operation or alignment between a Series with a MultiIndex and a Series with a flat Index on a shared level raises "ValueError: Length of values does not match length of index" when the shared level of the MultiIndex contains NaN, because _join_level drops the NaN codes.
workaround: Drop the MultiIndex rows that have NaN in the shared level before the operation (e.g. s1.iloc[1:] - s2), or recode those NaN values to a real level value.
